info.description:
- The course consists of 12 Units namely Reviewing the standard parts and format of an essay; choosing a topic; researching; outlining; avoiding plagiarism; the language of a research paper; writing the first draft; in-text citation; editing the paper; presenting the research.

- From Unit 1 to Unit 3, students finish draft of an essay on an assigned topic. From Unit 4 to Unit 12, students research information related to the essay topic from different sources in order to expand the essay into a 1000- word research including abstract, in-text citation and references
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: apprehend the process of developing a research from an essay, how to search, evaluate, cite information correctly form different sources, how to avoid plagiarism, edit and present a research
apply what they have learnt in this course in order to write a research and/or a researched essay of diverse genres; apply knowledge and skills in English writing in their lives and future profession
evaluate their own writing products and those of others; develop self-study skills to equip themselves with linguistics, vocabulary, and writing skills of a researched essay
Understand the importance of writing skills in English linguistics, life and their future profession; be self-reliant on knowledge and skills attained from this course
